decision_conditions: The proposals, by reason of their design and location, as well as their excessive mass, size, scale, bulk and form, would fail to preserve the character or appearance of the conservation area, harming the significance of this designated heritage asset, with no pubic or heritage benefits associated with such proposals. These proposals would also harm the significance of the host Building of Townscape Merit and neighbouring Buildings of Townscape Merit as a whole, as non-designated heritage assets. The scheme would therefore fail to be in accordance with the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990, NPPF (2026), London Plan (2021), Local Plan Policies 28, 29 and 30 and House Extensions and External Alterations SPD (2015).
description: Construction of a single-storey ground floor rear extension, first floor side extension, new entrance porch, replacement of existing windows, amendments to boundaries to the forecourt and first floor rear balcony and roof light to the side roof slope.
